entry.name: Revavroom-H4
entry.flavor: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.
abilities.textEs: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.
abilities.detailEs: Este Pokémon no recibe daño del clima.
abilities.detailZh: 该宝可梦不会受到天气的伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Este Pokémon não sofre dano de clima.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
abilities.textEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
abilities.detailEs: Este Pokémon recibe 0.75× de daño de los movimientos que son supereficaces contra él. Esta habilidad funciona de forma idéntica a Roca Sólida.
abilities.detailZh: 此宝可梦受到效果绝佳的招式攻击时，所受伤害变为0.75×。此特性的效果与坚硬岩石完全相同。
abilities.detailPt: Este Pokémon sofre 0.75× do dano de movimentos que são supereficazes contra ele. Esta habilidade funciona de forma idêntica a Solid Rock.
